Sanjay Padhye - Prabhat Studio – Capturing Memories with Excellence for Over 33 Years.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This studio is not just a place to get your photos taken; it's a hub of creativity and professionalism that caters to all your photography needs.

Expert Photography: The photographers at Colour King are true artists. They have an exceptional eye for detail and a knack for capturing the perfect moment. Whether it was a candid shot or a posed portrait, each picture they took was a masterpiece. Their understanding of lighting and angles brought out the best in every subject.

State-of-the-Art Editing: Post-photography, the magic of their editing skills came into play. The team at Colour King is adept at using the latest software to enhance photos without losing their natural charm. They skillfully balanced colors, adjusted brightness, and added subtle effects that made each photo pop.

Customized Physical Albums: What truly sets Colour King apart is their customized album service. They offer a range of high-quality albums that you can tailor to your preferences. The quality of the album materials is top-notch, ensuring that your memories are preserved in the best way possible. The layout and design of the albums are done with great care, reflecting a personal touch that resonates with your style.

Customer Service: The staff at Colour King are not only talented but also incredibly friendly and accommodating. featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry
No noise cancellation during speeches and parent testimonials
Overall output was unusable and disappointing
When we shared our feedback, he initially accepted his mistake. We requested to meet before the second event to clearly guide him on what needed coverage. After this, he stopped answering calls and messages.
As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.

name: Feather Touch Films
description:
Photography is an art, the practice of creating memorable images by capturing light through camera.
Feather Touch Films (FTF) is a young team of experienced, enthusiastic, energetic, creative professionals covering all aspects of the still and video services.

Our mission is to create a product that our clients are proud of and that showcases our clients’ events at par with highest standards.

Our commitment and passion to each individual project means that each client receives personal attention and efficient service from start to finish.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience with the FTF team for my wedding. Everything we’ve seen so far - photos, reels, and films - is beautifully captured. The candid shots stand out, and a special mention to the Mehndi photoshoot, which was outstanding.

Although the wedding photoshoot didn’t go exactly as planned due to time constraints, the FTF team did such an excellent job capturing candid moments with my close family and loved ones that I don’t feel disappointed about missing the formal wedding photoshoot at all.

The team was calm, patient, and highly professional throughout, making us feel completely comfortable. It truly felt like they were capturing moments for their own family.

Thank you to the entire FTF team for preserving our special moments so beautifully. Can't stop smiling looking at the photos and videos. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: The Team is wonderful especially  Om Desai, his vision, his expertise, his passion for his work makes him and his team one of the most dedicated people to invite for any of our Events or Functions. Had an amazing experience! They captured my brother’s engagement beautifully Om has great communication skills and good planning ahead of the event so he was always at the right place at the right time to capture the moment

featured_reviews.name: Umang Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommend OM and his team. FTF is an exceptional team to work with for any event. I had an incredible time with the entire crew—each one not only excels in their craft but also stands out as a remarkable individual. If you're planning a special occasion, I highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Kshitij Gharat
featured_reviews.review_text: Best Team in the Town❤️ Om, Kaustubh and Varun you guys are amazing. Did my Engagement, Pre Wedding , Wedding shoot from FTF and they are too good. Highly recommended without a single doubt.

featured_reviews.name: Kavita Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Feather Touch Films gave us memories for a lifetime. Every picture and video feels so real and full of emotion. They perfectly captured all the special moments of our big day. We couldn’t have asked for a better team! ❤️😍

featured_reviews.name: Rajnish Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience with Feather Touch Films! The quality, creativity, and attention to detail were top-notch. Highly recommend for anyone looking for beautiful, professional work.

featured_reviews.name: John Samuel
featured_reviews.review_text: Had been to a friends wedding, and saw these guys, they are just too good and highly professionals. I am surely recommending them for all your Photography needs.

featured_reviews.name: Shiv Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
FTF shot my sister's wedding, and they absolutely exceeded our expectations! Their team was incredibly professional, creative, and easy to work with.

They captured every special moment beautifully, ensuring no moment was missed. The candid shots were amazing and the cinematic wedding video felt no less than a movie

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst experience..Those who know little bit of photography will never visit here ..They charge like anything but editing and photos are worst .mainly use ai background and charge thousand for that .. totally worst experience.. featured_reviews.name: Delcy Arun
featured_reviews.review_text: Got Golden jubilee photos printed onto an Album, at Pixel Photo Studio. Omkar and his Father were very polite and courteous. Omkar was very patient and receptive to the ideas for the Album. Appreciate his prompt response and service delivery. The Album has turned out very well. Thank you Omkar, God bless you.

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Galgale
featured_reviews.review_text:
1) Quick and professional quality service
2) Friendly and respectful behaviour towards customer

featured_reviews.name: Kimberly Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my wedding album done here. Everything was great from designs to picture quality and Omkar was very prompt with giving us updates on progress of the album and getting it ready on time.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhavi Sankhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
We went to Pixel Photo Studio for our maternity shoot. Omkar was very professional and patient with the whole shoot and gave us ample time and ideas for pictures
He even took some retakes when we wanted to improvise our poses
The edited pictures came out really good and everyone loved it.
Definitely recommended for all kind of photos and events 👍

featured_reviews.name: Alphius Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: We got our daughter's First Holy Communion pictures printed into an album from Pixel Photo Studio. Omkar was very patient while hearing and then incorporating our requirements into the digital album. The album turned out impressive and we are very happy with it!!!

featured_reviews.name: Jon Ty
featured_reviews.review_text: I do love the welcome and the humility of the gentleman who runs this studio. He cares for his customers and builds a rapport to become friends. Easy to communicate and very down to earth gent. I will recommend all to visit him at least to say a hello if not for clicking pictures. Kudos to this studio

featured_reviews.name: Amruta Gadgil
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for someone to perfectly capture your special day/occasion, then look no further. Omkar and his team did an impeccable job with photography and videography for my wedding and related festivities. Cannot stop looking at my wedding photos and videos. Can't thank you enough.

Cherry on the cake is they're budget friendly, so you won't have to pay a bomb to get that finesse.

Custom size prints also possible. Photo albums for functions or get together designed, printed & bound in-house at Skylab. Gifting items like frames, T-shirt, Mugs & Art prints available.

featured_reviews.name: Pavitra Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my photographs printed here and I must say the quality of the print was amazing. I got my prints framed and it looks really nice

featured_reviews.name: Amit Gangapurkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The owner Mr. Avanindra Bhatia is Knowledgeable and Experienced, technically sound and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Lajja Rohit Naidu
featured_reviews.review_text:
My family has been getting our pictures taken here for decades. But in recent times they have not only become outdated but also complacent.
I tried getting my late mother's pic printed and the owner claimed it's very low resolution (2 inches), thus will cost more to edit it for printing A4 size. He gave me an estimate of ₹1000 including a simple frame. I had my doubts as the pic is 0.7 MB taken by a professional during a wedding. So I went to my local stationary guy and he did a perfect print for me with a simple frame for just ₹280. Never going to Skylab again.

featured_reviews.name: pranav magar
featured_reviews.review_text: Removing one star from my review as my recent experience was not good. When we went there for a small photo session, the lady at the counter and the photographer weren't very helpful and judged that we will not give them good business. He even bragged that our cameras cost more than a lakh and the photo will be good (felt like take it or leave it attitude). We still went ahead with the shoot and the photos were decent. After we gave them decent business, they were happy and started treating us with respect. All I am saying is to be nice to the customer and answer their queries gently rather than being judgemental about the business they may give you.

featured_reviews.name: nilanjana biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Skylab is an   excellent photography shop.
The quality of their passport photos is great. They also have a wide range of products on offer. They print on mugs, and also make prints of your artworks as well as framing.
The quality of their work can be seen from the books of photographs on sale.
Service is prompt and ambience is welcoming.

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: Freakishly their prices change as per your dressing. Taking advantage of the fact that very few photo labs around borivali their front desk has been given liberty it seems to talk anyway with customer. Also please note, as per their policy they do not do any editing of your passport size photos even tho they charge a bomb for the same.

featured_reviews.name: Rucha Kakkad
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you Skylab Colours for bringing all my memories as a teacher at one place. You were too prompt in your work than expected. It's a lifetime memory for me to cherish. Your work was very much appreciated by all those who saw it. Looking forward for building much more memories thru you.

featured_reviews.name: Rajula M
featured_reviews.review_text: With the recent experience of getting a collage printed I have experienced the highest level of customer service at Skylab Colours. The responses to the queries were answered around very quick. Answers were clear and easy to understand that helped me to make decisions quickly. Your special skills and techniques are impressive in the final laminated  picture. You have created a lifetime memory to cherish !! Thankyou Skylab Colours.
